note: Qiblai's own library families, bound onto its MAT keys by src/89q0z-qb-matlib.js (KMAT.bindMat('qiblai')); the kit also draws in the Xanadu kit's sets, which Xanadu's own pack binds (settlements/xanadu/materials.json). qAshlar: the dressed ashlar of the plinths, the terrace platforms and the ring walls' base courses, half-metre courses on a 3 m tile, tinted by QSTONE (reused from Ys's arcades, stone.sandstone.ashlar; the owner, 2026-11-11: new textures for Qiblai). Owed (core/materials/PROMPTS-NEEDED.md section 43): the beaten-gold roof sheet and the prayer-wheel copper with mantra relief. The city's ground (2026-11-11, the owner: 'the ground is blindingly textureless'): qGrass (ground.grass.lush, the Af country), qDirt (ground.dirt, the blocks' made ground), qCobble (paving.cobblestone_01, the lay streets), qFlag (paving.flagstone, the avenues and the kora); keep 1: the sets' own colours, the city's ground shader blends them by a zone mask (settlements/qiblai/targets/city/90q-qc-world.js). The rooms (2026-11-15, the owner: 'make sure textures are wired appropriately to all furniture and floor, ceiling and walls of rooms'): qGilt (metal.gold, the gilt inside, tinted by each piece's gold), qLacq (wood.lacquer: columns and painted ceilings, tinted by each piece's colour), qMarble (paving.marble_mosaic_tiles: the sanctum's floor), qPlank (wood.old_wooden_floor_02: the halls' floors), qRug (cloth.rug.wool: the council's runner, tinted red).
